name: toggle_night_tiles
purpose: Day/night map switch for the loaded floor. Pass 1: for every tile 0x87 the tile at (y+1, same x) is XORed with 0xdd (lit/unlit lamp variant). Pass 2 (skipped while the party stands on an annotation tile 0x48/0x49): every annotation cell recorded by load_town_map gets its original tile back when g_hour == 5, otherwise tile 3. Sets g_view_dirty |= 2. Called by load_town_map at night, by town_main_loop at the 20:00 and 05:00 transitions, and via vector 1778:031a by CMDS/SHOPPES3.
notes: Tile meanings (0x87, 0x48/0x49, 3) inferred from the code only.

name: blight_map_for_shadowlord
purpose: When g_shadowlord_present != -1: seeds the RNG with g_day, then for each of the 1024 map bytes replaces 0x2d by 0x2c and 0x2e by 0x2b with probability 7/8 (rand_range(7,0) != 0), sets g_view_dirty |= 2 and reseeds the RNG from get_time_hash(). The day seed keeps the blight pattern stable across reloads within one day.

name: spawn_shadowlord

If present: blight_map_for_shadowlord; if any monster slot already has tile 0xfc, return. Else find_spawn_slot, choose the highest NPC index with type 0 (31 if none), and fill: state active, g_npc_slot = slot, slot x = 15 / g_npc_x = 15, slot y = g_npc_y = DGROUP byte table 0x13a5[g_location] (Shadowlord spawn y per location), value3/z/value1/value2 = 0, g_npc_z = 0, slot tile/anim = 0xfc, schedule times zeroed, three schedule entries (AI 6, x 15, y as above, z 0), type 0xfc.

name: load_town_map
purpose: Loads and prepares the current floor. draw_sky_strip_frame, draw_sky_strip, set_wind_and_draw(-1), g_door_tile = 0, g_chunk_x/y = 0. floor = DGROUP 0x1e19[g_location] + g_party_z (minus 0x100 when z >= 0x80, i.e. basements); load_file_region(floor << 10, 0x400, g_map, name) with name = g_map_dat_name_ptrs[(location-1) >> 3] (TOWNE/DWELLING/CASTLE/KEEP.DAT). Clears the annotation table and light beams (-1), scans the map (outer x, inner y): tiles 0x48/0x49 are appended to the annotation table (x, y, tile); the first '*' (0x2a) becomes beam 1, any later '*' overwrites beam 2. toggle_night_tiles when hour < 5 or > 19; rebuild_light_map; pass_time(0); blight_map_for_shadowlord; init_town_npcs when init_npcs != 0; g_view_dirty = 1.

name: use_stairs
proto: void use_stairs(int tile, unsigned dir)  /* Ghidra (param_1=tile, param_2=dir) */
purpose: After a step: if tile is a directional stair 0xc4..0xc7, refresh_map_view; when tile-0xc4 == dir (0=N 1=E 2=S 3=W) the party goes up a floor ('Up!'), when tile-0xc4 == dir^2 down ('Down!'), otherwise nothing; the new floor is loaded with load_town_map(1). cmd_klimb_town calls it with (0xc4, 0) for up and (0xc4, 2) for down.

name: turn_vehicle_town
purpose: Settlement version of the vehicle turn: horse (0x10 group) prints 'Ride ' and faces E (0x12) or W (0x13); carpet (0x14) prints 'Fly ' and faces E (0x14) / W (0x15); frigate (0x20/0x24) or skiff (0x28, prints 'Row ') gets base + dir.

name: move_party_town
purpose: Moves the party one step (dir key 1=W 2=E 3=N 4=S); returns 1 when the party left the settlement, else 0. Footstep on foot/horse. Per direction: dx/dy, leaving flag if the party is at the map edge (x/y < 1 or > 30), turn_vehicle_town and the direction name. Destination view tile vt = g_view_tiles[5+dy][5+dx]; obj = find_object_at(z, y+dy, x+dx). An object blocks unless boardable: on a vessel (transport 0x20..0x2f) only an anchored frigate 0x24..0x27 from a skiff (>= 0x28); otherwise 0x24..0x2b, 0x1b, horses 0x10/0x11, 0x1e, 0x1f. Then can_enter_tile(vt, transport). Allowed and not leaving: move, g_view_dirty = 1, horse footstep, use_stairs(vt, dir). Leaving: 'Dost thou wish to leave?' Y/N/ESC: Y -> 'Yes Exit to Underworld!' (location 0x19, z = 0xff) or 'Britannia!' (z = 0), door cleared, party x/y = tables 0x1e89/0x1eb1[location], g_location = 0, return 1; N/ESC -> 'No'. Blocked: 'Blocked!', beep, flush_keyboard. Ghidra split the function into 87d0 + 88bc/88c8/88ea/890c/892e.

name: cmd_attack_town
purpose: The Attack command in settlements (ROOT dispatch_command 'A'; vector 1778:036e). Prints 'Attack-'; on a water tile (< 4) while not on foot: 'On foot!' returns 0. get_direction (0 -> return 1). Target (x+dx, y+dy): a mirror 0x9d becomes 0x9f with 'Broken!' and rising tones (play_random_tones f,120,40 for f = 2000..19000 step 1000), view dirty |2, return 1. obj = find_object_at(z,y,x) (slot in g_dx -> npc = find_npc_by_slot); attackable when obj >= 0x40, not 0xe8..0xef and group != 0xb4, else 'Nothing to attack!'. obj < 0x80: karma -= 5 and raise_alarm; group 0xd8: raise_alarm only. If the target's map tile is not one of 0x84, 0x85, 0x9f, 0xab: set_npc_killed + fight_npc (if npc >= 0). Otherwise (sleeping/behind bars) obj 0x78 -> 'Missed!', else 'Murdered!', karma -= 5, flash_tile_at, set_npc_killed + remove_npc. Returns 1.

notes: local npc is uninitialised in the original when obj == 0 but never read then.

name: cmd_klimb_town
purpose: The Klimb command in settlements (dispatch_command 'K', vector 1778:034a). 'Klimb-'; on horseback '-On foot!' returns 0. Standing on tile 0x86 or 0xc9: use_stairs(0xc4,2) (down); 0xc8: use_stairs(0xc4,0) (up); returns 1. Otherwise get_direction; target tile must be 'L' (0x4c), 0xca or 0xcb else 'What?' returns 0; the party steps there, g_view_dirty = 1, refresh_map_view; returns 1 (also when no direction was given).

name: wander_horses
purpose: Each turn, every monster slot with a horse tile (0x10/0x11) on the party's floor moves with 50% chance if none of its four neighbours is a hitching tile: 50% vertical by +-1, else horizontal by +-1 with the facing tile set to 0x11 (west) or 0x10 (east). The target must be within 0..31, pass can_enter_tile(tile, 0x10) and have no object (find_object_at_rev); then tile/anim tile/x/y are updated and g_view_dirty |= 2.

name: read_town_command
purpose: With redraw != 0: refresh_map_view, draw_status_window if g_status_dirty (then clear it), put_char(10), draw_bar_left_cap. key = read_command_key. If g_drunk_moves != 0, with 50% chance: raise_alarm, g_drunk_moves--, 'Hic!', key = random entry of the 4-byte table 0x2742 (3,4,2,1 = N,S,E,W). Returns the key.

name: handle_number_key
purpose: Digit keys in a settlement. If g_view_tiles[6][5] (the tile south of the party, 0xabc7) is 0x8d (harpsichord): n = key-'0'; with sound on play_sweep_noise(0xfffc, 0x4e20, 4000, 1, word table 0x2746[n]) (note frequencies 0x1eab,0x0c2c,0x0da9,0x0f56,0x103f,0x123c,0x1478,0x16fa,0x1857,0x1b53). Melody matcher: pos = byte 0x2767; if 0x275a[pos] == n then pos++ and when pos reaches 13 it resets to 0 and, in Castle British (0x11) on floor 2, g_map byte 0x67b9 (row 13 col 17) ^= 0xb, earthquake_shake, g_view_dirty = 1 (the secret passage). Else pos==10 && n==8 -> 3; pos==11 && n==7 -> 2; n == first note -> 1; else 0. Returns 3 (no turn). Otherwise returns set_active_player(key). Melody at 0x275a: 6 7 8 9 8 7 8 7 6 7 6 5 3.

name: apply_tile_hazards
purpose: Per-turn hazards. Each sleeping member ('S') wakes ('G') with chance 1/16. Loop: tile under party t. t == 0x8c (trapdoor) and not on a carpet: 'A TRAPDOOR!', damage_whole_party with transport temporarily 0, then in Stonegate (0x1d): set_color(0), fill_rect(0xb7,0xb7,8,8), falling tone 1000 down to 251 (start_tone/delay_loop(40,1)), stop_tone, g_map filled with 0x8f, g_view_dirty = 1, monster table zeroed, every member HP = 0 and status 'D' with play_random_tones(500,3000,40) and status redraw; elsewhere g_party_z--, load_town_map(1) and the loop repeats. t == 4 (swamp) on foot: each member not 'D'/'P' whose dexterity < rand_range(29,0) gets 'Poisoned!' and status 'P'. t == 0xbc or 0x8f (fire/lava): refresh_map_view, 'Burning!', damage_whole_party. Finally end_of_turn_party_update.

If arrived: tile byte of monster slots 1..31 = 0, g_drunk_moves = 0, g_map_update_enabled = 1, NPC a290() (NPC overlay reset) and NPC a366(g_hour) (schedule evaluation). g_shadowlord_present = -1; load_town_map(arrived); spawn_shadowlord; remove every NPC with is_npc_killed; in Stonegate (0x1d) with the sceptre owned remove NPC 9; draw_status_window; if find_first_conscious_member >= 0: refresh_map_view and, in Stonegate, print_air_of for each Shadowlord whose g_shadowlord_loc < 0x80 (2,1,0), elsewhere print_air_of(present) + shadowlord_influence_npcs.

purpose: In Castle Blackthorn (0x12): return 0 if nobody is conscious, else BLCKTHRN a89e (the dungeon scene, vector 1778:033e). Elsewhere: '"Thou art under arrest!"' '"Wilt thou come quietly?"' read Y/N; N: '"Then defend thyself, rogue!"', raise_alarm, return 1 (caller attacks). Y: 'The guard strikes thee unconscious!', set_color(0), 'Thou dost awaken to...', g_location = 4, x = 25, y = 4, g_view_dirty = 1, pass_time(20) until 08:00, g_keys = 0, g_party_z = 0. Then enter_town(1); return 0.
notes: Location 4 at (25,4) is the Yew jail where the guards drop the party.

name: town_main_loop
purpose: Entry point (vector 1778:02d2) from ROOT main after enter_town; returns when g_location == 0. Per pass: find_first_conscious_member: 1 -> newline, prompt cap, 'Zzzzzz...' (turn passes); -1 -> BLCKTHRN aba0 (resurrection, cmd = 0); else moongate check via enter_moongate unless g_just_entered (which is cleared), a moongate trip runs CAST2 f056; return if g_location == 0; then read_town_command(redraw once) until cmd != 3: key >= 0x20 -> dispatch_command, digits -> handle_number_key, 1..4 -> move_party_town (leave = result, cmd = !leave), 5 -> 'Exit to DOS?' Y: restore_video_mode + exit(0) else 'N'; 0xb -> karma printed; 0x13 -> 'Sound On/Off' toggle; 0x16 -> '1.16'; else 'What?' (cmd = 0 for these). After: g_location == 0 -> leave; else if cmd != 0 and someone is conscious: pass_time(1); toggle_night_tiles when the hour changed to 20 or 5; apply_tile_hazards; door timer countdown closes the door (set_town_map_tile); party slot x/y/z = party; then unless status icon 'T', and only on alternate turns while on horseback (0x12..0x15, key != space) or with 'Q': wander_horses, NPC b044(hour) when cmd < 2, handle_npc_contact(cmd-1) when g_npc_contact_idx != 0 or cmd == 2.

name: init_town_npcs
purpose: Vector 1778:030e (also CMDS, SHOPPES3). Clears monster slots 1..31 (set_monster_slot all 0) and g_npc_slot of NPCs 1..31. For each NPC 1..31 with non-zero type: idx = NPC b570(g_hour, npc) (schedule entry 0..2 for the hour), place_npc(z=sched+9+idx, y=sched+6+idx, x=sched+3+idx, npc), state active, g_npc_sched_idx = idx, g_npc_move_list_ptrs[npc] = 0xffff.

name: place_npc
proto: void place_npc(unsigned z, unsigned y, unsigned x, int npc)  /* Ghidra (param_1=z, param_2=y, param_3=x, param_4=npc) */
purpose: Vector 1778:03aa (NPC overlay). For a non-zero type: if z != party floor and the NPC has a slot: slot tile = 0, link = 0. If z == party floor and no slot: s = find_spawn_slot; value1 = 0x1e for type 1, else 0xff when bit npc of the 32-bit table 0x28c2[g_location] is set, else 0; set_monster_slot(s, value1, z, y, x, type, type); anim state = 0; link = s. If z == party floor with a slot: slot x/y/z = x/y/z. Always: g_npc_x/y/z = x/y/z, state active.
